purpose: Determine whether P4.3 C1 misses and excessive false positives originate in the upstream EOMER clefs_keys mask or in the downstream geometric staff-anchor adapter, without rerunning the full 29-page corpus.

selectedPages.reason: Mixed C1/C3/C4 page with 2 C1 teacher boxes, 17 false positives and 3 false negatives; high-yield C1 plus overgeneration diagnostic.
C3 development page with 0 true positives, 3 false positives and 1 false negative; distinguishes upstream miss from adapter admission failure.
C4 development page with 1 true positive and 18 false positives; strong overgeneration control while C4 localization itself succeeds.

diagnosticQuestions: Does each C1 teacher box contain any upstream clefs_keys positive pixels?
What fraction of each teacher box is covered by the upstream clefs_keys mask?
Does any raw connected component overlap each missed teacher box before adapter filtering?
How many raw components occur in the staff-start region on high-FP pages?
Are false positives already present as upstream mask components or mainly introduced by adapter component merging/admission?
